title: Quarry
subtitle: Free, digs to bedrock
text:
The Quarry needs no power. It sits at a corner and digs the area beside it, layer by layer down to bedrock, skipping air and fluids. Without Landmarks it takes 16x16; set Landmarks up to 64 blocks away, one in line with its front and one to a side.

The Electric Drill in its assembly sets the speed: 1 block/s, x1.5 on steel, x1.25 for a steel drill body, plus the drill's upgrades. A diamond bit digs obsidian. Outputs go into a chest or pipe beside it. Fit a Pipe Filter to choose what it keeps.
